def evolved_p101(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i,j] = (i XOR j) if (i+j) % 2 == 0 else 0
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    xor = torch.zeros(N, N, device=x.device, dtype=idx.dtype)
    b = 1
    while b < N:
        bi = (ii // b) % 2
        bj = (jj // b) % 2
        diff = (bi + bj) % 2
        xor = xor + diff * b
        b = b * 2
    mask = ((ii + jj) % 2 == 0).to(xor.dtype)
    out = xor * mask
    return out.contiguous().to(x.dtype)
